list.name: First Blood (Yours)
list.quip: Welcome to the experience. It only gets worse.

list.name: Tour of the Graveyard
list.quip: You know the spirit healer by first name now.

list.name: Professional Corpse
list.quip: You have spent more time dead than some crawlers have spent alive.

list.name: Spirit Healer Loyalty Card
list.quip: Your tenth resurrection is free. That is not how it works.

list.name: Gravity Is a Suggestion
list.quip: You jumped. You died. The System calls that cause and effect.

list.name: Glub Glub
list.quip: Breathing: a skill you have yet to unlock.

list.name: Speedrun to the Spirit Healer
list.desc: Die within 10 seconds of coming back to life.
list.quip: New personal record. The System is impressed. That is a lie.

list.name: Tour Guide
list.desc: Run back to your corpse 25 times.
list.quip: Your feet know every graveyard path by heart.

list.name: Group Hug
list.quip: Teamwork makes the dream work. Dream status: deceased.

list.name: Mongo Is Appalled
list.quip: Nobody knows what you did. Mongo knows.

list.name: Bunny Hopper
list.quip: Your knees have unionized. Your feet filed a complaint.

list.name: Pogo Crawler
list.quip: The System stopped counting. It is lying. The System never stops counting.

list.name: Dance Floor Champion
list.quip: The judges rate your footwork 3 out of 10. Generous.

list.name: Ugly Crier
list.quip: The viewers love this. Do it again.

list.name: Hug Dealer
list.quip: Consent forms have been filed retroactively.

list.name: Rude
list.quip: The System approves of your attitude.

list.name: Chicken Whisperer
list.quip: It did not respond. It never does.

list.name: Couch Potato
list.desc: Stay AFK for 30 minutes in a rested area.
list.quip: You are now a decorative statue. Your feet are asleep too.

list.name: Dungeon Tourist
list.quip: Postcards not included. Blisters included.

list.name: Lost
list.quip: Do you need a map? The System could provide one. It will not.

list.name: Pocket Lint
list.quip: Retirement plan: started.

list.name: Dragon Hoard
list.quip: Shiny. The System requests a loan.

list.name: Bankrupt
list.desc: Hit 0 copper after having over 1 gold.
list.quip: Gone. All of it. Spent on what, exactly?

list.name: Repair Bill Enjoyer
list.quip: Your armor is held together by spite and receipts.

list.name: Vendor's Best Friend
list.quip: The merchant has named a yacht after you.

list.name: First Purple
list.quip: Purple! Do a little dance. Not that dance.

list.name: Hoarder
list.quip: The System has seen your bags. The System is concerned.

list.name: Patient Angler
list.quip: Thrilling content. The viewers are asleep.

list.name: Boot Fisher
list.quip: Congratulations. It is a boot. No feet inside, sadly.

list.name: Chatterbox
list.quip: The System is listening. The System wishes it were not.

list.name: Needy
list.quip: Help Wanted. Help Wanted. HELP WANTED. Got it.

list.name: Got It Done
list.quip: Mildly competent. Disturbing.

list.name: Event Planner
list.quip: Your calendar is more organized than your life.

list.name: Party Animal
list.quip: You came for loot. You stayed for chaos.

list.name: Welcome Wagon
list.quip: Fresh meat delivered. The dungeon thanks you.

list.name: Recruiter Supreme
list.quip: Pyramid scheme detected. The System approves.

list.name: Biography Complete
list.desc: Fill in your bio, roles and play times.
list.quip: The System now knows everything about you. Including your shoe size.

list.name: Bookworm
list.quip: Reading! In a dungeon! How quaint.

list.name: Altaholic
list.quip: Five of you. Ten feet. The dungeon trembles. Mildly.

list.name: Answered the Call
list.quip: Somebody yelled. You came running. On foot, presumably.

list.name: Welcome Committee
list.quip: Every new crawler got a hello and a foot inspection.

list.name: Night Crawler
list.quip: Go to bed. That is an order. Ignored, naturally.

list.name: Early Bird
list.quip: Is the coffee in your bags? Please say yes.

list.name: One More Floor
list.quip: Hydrate. Stretch. Wiggle your toes. Keep crawling.

list.name: Loyal Viewer
list.quip: Your dedication has been noted. And mocked.

list.name: Ding! (10)
list.quip: Now slightly harder to kill.

list.name: Ding! (20)
list.quip: Your sponsors have noticed. They yawned.

list.name: Ding! (30)
list.quip: Survival odds adjusted from no to unlikely.

list.name: Ding! (40)
list.quip: Mount acquired? Your feet thank you.

list.name: Ding! (50)
list.quip: The viewers are cautiously invested.

list.name: Ding! (60)
list.quip: Maximum level. Minimum dignity. Congratulations.

list.name: Achievement Hunter
list.quip: An achievement for achievements. The System is very lazy.

list.name: Click Clicker
list.quip: It is a paw. It does not do anything else.

list.name: Foot Inspector
list.quip: You were looking at their boots. The System saw.

list.name: Box Addict
list.quip: The System has notified your sponsors of your problem.

list.name: Frequent Flier (Spirit Edition)
list.quip: The spirit healer has started saving you a seat.

list.name: The Ghost With the Most
list.quip: You are more ghost than crawler at this point.

list.name: Immortal, Technically Not
list.quip: A thousand deaths. Zero lessons. Impressive consistency.

list.name: Gravity Fan Club
list.desc: Die within 5 seconds of jumping, 10 times.
list.quip: Gravity has added you to its newsletter.

list.name: Professional Swimmer (Former)
list.desc: Die while out of breath 10 times.
list.quip: Gills: still not unlocked.

list.name: Marathon Corpse
list.desc: Run back to your corpse 100 times.
list.quip: Your ghost feet have excellent cardio.

list.name: Graveyard Shift
list.desc: Run back to your corpse 250 times.
list.quip: You could give tours. You basically do.

list.name: Took the Shortcut
list.quip: Your gear has filed a formal complaint.

list.name: Spirit Healer Regular
list.desc: Resurrect at a spirit healer 10 times.
list.quip: The spirit healer knows your order by heart.

list.name: Synchronized Dying
list.desc: Your whole party dies together 5 times.
list.quip: Olympic-level teamwork. Wrong event.

list.name: Speedrun Any%
list.desc: Die within 10 seconds of coming back, 5 times.
list.quip: A new world record every time. The bar is underground.

list.name: Edge of the World
list.quip: There is nothing out there. Except tired feet.

list.name: Picks Fights
list.quip: Conflict resolution: punching.

list.name: Violence Enthusiast
list.quip: The viewers love you. The wildlife does not.

list.name: Combat Is a Lifestyle
list.quip: Peace has been tried. You did not care for it.

list.name: Button Masher
list.quip: Your keybinds are filing for overtime.

list.name: Keyboard Warrior
list.quip: Somewhere, a keycap is weeping.

list.name: Your Keyboard Is Crying
list.quip: The System has ordered your keyboard a therapist.

list.name: Dance Floor Legend
list.quip: Your feet are registered as a public hazard.

list.name: Feet of Fury
list.quip: The floor has asked for a restraining order against your feet.

list.name: Professional Sadness
list.quip: The ratings have never been higher.

list.name: Hug Tycoon
list.quip: You have hugged a small town.

list.name: Absolutely Feral
list.quip: The System has never been prouder.

list.name: Spring-Loaded
list.quip: Your feet have not touched the ground since Tuesday.

list.name: Kangaroo Court
list.quip: The verdict: excessive bouncing. Sentence: more bouncing.

list.name: Advanced Furniture
list.desc: Stay AFK in a rested area for 30 minutes, 5 times.
list.quip: Several guests have tried to sit on you.

list.name: Hello, Is It Me
list.quip: Hello. Hello. Hello. Yes, we see you.

list.name: Professional Waver
list.quip: Your arm has unionized with your feet.

list.name: Hype Crawler
list.quip: Enthusiasm detected. Source: unclear.

list.name: Very Polite Murderer
list.quip: Manners before mayhem.

list.name: Laugh Track
list.quip: The System pays you in exposure.

list.name: Smooch Bandit
list.quip: Hygiene report pending.

list.name: Do You Even Crawl
list.quip: Impressive. Mostly to you.

list.name: Nap Champion
list.quip: The dungeon does not have nap time. You made one.

list.name: Professional Sitter
list.quip: Your feet thank you for your service.

list.name: Inner Beast
list.quip: The wildlife is unimpressed.

list.name: Udderly Ridiculous
list.quip: The System is reevaluating your species.

list.name: All Aboard
list.quip: Choo choo. Please stop.

list.name: World's Smallest Violin
list.quip: Played with feeling. Badly.

list.name: Brave Sir Crawler
list.quip: Bravely ran away. Repeatedly.

list.name: Tactical Retreat
list.quip: Your feet have the best survival instincts in the guild.

list.name: Will Crawl for Food
list.quip: Dignity: sold.

list.name: Slap Happy
list.quip: HR has been notified. There is no HR.

list.name: Poke Master
list.quip: Everyone is very annoyed. Keep going.

list.name: Disappointed in Everyone
list.quip: The System shares your pain.

list.name: Slow Clap
list.quip: Clap. Clap. Clap. Sarcasm detected.

list.name: Gratitude Machine
list.quip: You are welcome. The System did nothing.

list.name: Yes, System!
list.quip: At ease, crawler. Wiggle your toes.

list.name: Bend the Knees
list.quip: Your knees have opinions about this.

list.name: Shy Crawler
list.quip: Hiding behind your own feet. Bold strategy.

list.name: Are We There Yet
list.quip: We are not there yet.

list.name: Deep Sighs
list.quip: Exhaling at professional levels.

list.name: Bawk Bawk
list.quip: The chickens consider you one of their own.

list.name: Coin Goblin
list.quip: The System can hear the coins jingling from here.

list.name: Dragon Hoard Deluxe
list.quip: Sleeping on it is not recommended. Do it anyway.

list.name: Literal Royalty
list.quip: Commoners may now kiss your boots. Feet optional.

list.name: Lint Collector
list.quip: A fortune, one copper at a time.

list.name: Financial Wizard (Ironic)
list.desc: Hit 0 copper after having over 1 gold, 3 times.
list.quip: Spend it all. Again. Bold.

list.name: Armor Is a Subscription
list.quip: Your armor has a monthly plan now.

list.name: Blacksmith's Retirement Fund
list.quip: A blacksmith bought a yacht. You did that.

list.name: Vendor Trash Tycoon
list.quip: Your bags are a thrift store.

list.name: Junk Mogul
list.quip: You have personally funded the merchant economy.

list.name: Fish Whisperer
list.quip: The fish have started a support group.

list.name: The Lake Fears You
list.quip: Somewhere, a lake is empty because of you.

list.name: Boot Collector
list.quip: Still no feet inside. The System checked every one.

list.name: You've Got Junk Mail
list.quip: It is mostly bills. And boots.

list.name: Market Watcher
list.quip: You refresh more than the System does.

list.name: Vault Dweller
list.quip: Your money is lonely. Visit it more.

list.name: Haggler
list.quip: Two crawlers, one trade window, endless suspicion.

list.name: Learning Stuff
list.quip: Knowledge! The System is mildly surprised.

list.name: Recipe Hoarder
list.quip: You know how to make everything except good decisions.

list.name: Master Crafter-ish
list.quip: Crafting legend. Feet still unwashed.

list.name: Dungeon Backpacker
list.quip: Your boots have more passport stamps than you do.

list.name: Seen It All
list.quip: The map is now just a scrapbook.

list.name: Frequent Flier
list.quip: Your feet appreciate the break.

list.name: Gryphon Points Member
list.quip: The gryphons know your name. They do not like it.

list.name: There's No Place Like Home
list.quip: Click your heels. Wrong game. Close enough.

list.name: Homebody
list.quip: The innkeeper has stopped asking.

list.name: Regular at the Inn
list.quip: The usual table. The usual stool. The usual feet on the table.

list.name: The Usual, Please
list.quip: Your name is carved into the bar.

list.name: Into the Dungeon
list.quip: Welcome to the actual dungeon. Mind your feet.

list.name: Floor Inspector
list.quip: You rate floors now. Mostly sticky.

list.name: Floor Collector
list.quip: Ten floors. Countless traps. Zero regrets.

list.name: Every Floor, Every Door
list.quip: The dungeon is starting to feel like home. Concerning.

list.name: Mermaid in Training
list.quip: Fins: pending. Feet: wrinkly.

list.name: Errand Crawler
list.quip: Ten strangers helped. Zero thanks received.

list.name: Quest Goblin
list.quip: You have collected so many boar livers.

list.name: Professional Errand Runner
list.quip: Your feet have walked across the world. Twice.

list.name: Nobody Asked, You Delivered
list.quip: Every exclamation point fears you.

list.name: Never Stops Typing
list.quip: The System has muted you in its heart.

list.name: Guild Chat Is My Home
list.quip: You have written a novel. Mostly lol.

list.name: Psst
list.quip: Secrets! The System is listening anyway.

list.name: Talking to Strangers
list.quip: The town square knows your voice.

list.name: INDOOR VOICE
list.quip: PLEASE USE YOUR INDOOR VOICE.

list.name: Very Needy
list.quip: The board is basically your diary.

list.name: Professional Help Seeker
list.quip: You have outsourced your entire life.

list.name: Reliable Crawler
list.quip: Things get done around you. Suspicious.

list.name: Social Director
list.quip: The calendar bows to you.

list.name: Always Down
list.quip: You have never said no. Concerning.

list.name: Has No Other Plans
list.quip: The guild is your whole personality now.

list.name: Meat Shield Volunteer
list.quip: Face first. Feet second. Brain optional.

list.name: Band-Aid Brigade
list.quip: Keeping idiots alive since forever.

list.name: Big Numbers Energy
list.quip: Numbers go up. Brain goes off.

list.name: Cult Leader
list.quip: The System is legally required to call this a guild.

list.name: Professional Greeter
list.quip: Every one of them got a foot inspection.

list.name: First to the Gates
list.quip: You heard the call. Your feet were already running.

list.name: Party Starter
list.quip: The more the merrier. The more the deadlier.

list.name: Group Hug Enthusiast
list.quip: You have been in more parties than a balloon.

list.name: Square Up
list.quip: Win or lose, your feet were involved.

list.name: Duelist
list.quip: The town square is your arena now.

list.name: Ready Checked
list.quip: Ready? You were not. You clicked yes anyway.

list.name: Professional Spectator
list.quip: Watching other people succeed. A true crawler pastime.

list.name: HR Department
list.quip: The System has given you a lanyard.

list.name: Bouncer
list.quip: Not on the list. Not with those shoes.

list.name: Town Crier
list.quip: HEAR YE. Mostly people ignored you.

list.name: Family Tree
list.quip: You have untangled the guild's family drama.

list.name: Week One
list.quip: A full week. The System has not gotten bored of you yet.

list.name: Committed
list.quip: This is a relationship now.

list.name: Lifer
list.quip: The dungeon has started paying you rent.

list.name: Year of the Crawl
list.quip: A full year. The System baked you a cake. It is a lie.

list.name: Click Login, Repeat
list.quip: The login screen music lives in your head now.

list.name: A Full Day
list.quip: Twenty-four hours. Have you seen the sun?

list.name: Basically a Job
list.quip: Benefits not included. Foot cramps included.

list.name: The Dungeon Is Home Now
list.quip: Your chair has a permanent dent.

list.name: One More Floor (For Real)
list.quip: The System is now legally your roommate.

list.name: Creature of the Night
list.desc: Be online at 3 AM on 10 different nights.
list.quip: Sleep is for crawlers with lives.

list.name: Weekend Warrior
list.desc: Play on a Saturday and a Sunday.
list.quip: Touching grass postponed again.

list.name: Spooky Crawler
list.quip: The scariest thing here is your gear.

list.name: Crawling Through the Snow
list.quip: The System got you socks. For your feet. Obviously.

list.name: New Year, Same Crawler
list.quip: New year resolution: die less. Status: failed.

list.name: Ding! (15)
list.quip: Fifteen levels of questionable choices.

list.name: Ding! (25)
list.quip: Halfway-ish. Do not get comfortable.

list.name: Ding! (35)
list.quip: Your feet have grown three sizes. Probably.

list.name: Ding! (45)
list.quip: The end is in sight. It is still far.

list.name: Ding! (55)
list.quip: Five more. The System believes in you. A little.

list.name: Regular Viewer
list.quip: You are now part of the ratings.

list.name: Can't Stop Watching
list.quip: Please blink. For the System.

list.name: Theme Hopper
list.quip: Indecisive. Fashionable. Both.

list.name: Rebrand
list.desc: Give the window your own guild name.
list.quip: New name, same chaos.

list.name: Shh
list.quip: The System is sulking. Quietly.

list.name: Celestial Being
list.quip: The heavens opened. It was mostly confetti.

list.name: Collector of Junk
list.quip: A shelf full of nothing. Beautiful.

list.name: Museum of Nonsense
list.quip: Admission is free. Nobody comes.

list.name: Many Names
list.quip: You have more names than friends.

list.name: Name Tag
list.quip: Now everyone knows. Unfortunately.

list.name: Roasted
list.desc: Get a personal roast from a loot box.
list.quip: The System wrote it about you. It was not kind.

list.name: Framed
list.desc: Get a name frame from a loot box.
list.quip: Your name has never looked so expensive.

list.name: Box Hoarder
list.quip: The System has notified your sponsors. Again.

list.name: Unboxing Channel
list.quip: Like and subscribe. The System does not know what that means.

list.name: Overachiever
list.quip: Achievement unlocked: achieving.

list.name: Completionist (Allegedly)
list.quip: You have a problem. The System respects it.

list.name: Touch Grass
list.quip: Go outside. Walk around. Feel the grass with your feet.

list.name: Window Shopper
list.quip: Just browsing. Mostly the boots.

list.name: Very Curious
list.quip: You know everyone's gear better than they do.

list.name: Paw Addict
list.quip: It is still just a paw.

list.name: Alt Army
list.quip: Twenty feet. One person. Too many hats.

list.name: This Is a Feature
list.quip: Not a bug. Never a bug.

list.name: Floor One Survivor
list.quip: Congratulations, crawler. You are now slightly less likely to die immediately.

list.name: Box Hoarder
list.quip: You opened them all at once. The System respects a lack of restraint.

list.name: Sponsor Bait
list.quip: The viewers are watching your feet. They have opinions.

list.name: Crowd Pleaser
list.quip: Ratings are up. Your survival odds are not.

list.name: Recurring Character
list.quip: The audience recognizes you now. Mostly from the death reel.

list.name: Safe Room Regular
list.quip: The bartender has stopped asking. Your usual is already poured.

list.name: Show for the Audience
list.quip: Nobody asked. Everybody watched.

list.name: Find the Stairwell
list.quip: You went down. You came back up. Do it again.

list.name: Party of Crawlers
list.quip: Strength in numbers. Also more people to blame.

list.name: Sponsored
list.quip: A sponsor noticed you. It wants its logo on your boots.

list.name: Quest Fodder
list.quip: Fifty errands for strangers. The System calls it content.

list.name: Halfway Down
list.quip: The floors get worse from here. That is a promise.

list.name: Window Shopper
list.quip: You keep checking. The System keeps watching you check.

list.name: Hype Crawler
list.quip: The System did not need encouragement. It took it anyway.

list.name: Royal Treatment
list.quip: Bow before the fluff. The System is legally required to say that.

list.name: Cat Nap
list.desc: Go AFK in a rested area 3 times.
list.quip: Sixteen hours a day is a healthy amount of nap. The System checked.

list.name: Professional Napper
list.quip: You have napped on every flat surface in Azeroth. Several twice.

list.name: Aloof
list.quip: You want attention. But not like that.

list.name: Knock It Off the Table
list.quip: You pushed it. You watched it fall. You felt nothing.

list.name: Fish Tax
list.quip: Half of them are for you. The other half are also for you.

list.name: Unimpressed
list.quip: The dungeon tried its best. You yawned.

list.name: Swat
list.quip: No claws. This time.

list.name: Sit in Every Box
list.quip: Every zone is a box if you believe hard enough.

list.name: Not a Lap Cat
list.quip: You allowed it. Briefly. On your terms.

list.name: Zoomies
list.quip: 3 a.m. energy at any hour. The System is concerned.

list.name: Nine Lives
list.quip: That was all nine. The System is issuing more. Do not tell anyone.

list.name: Wrong Animal
list.quip: You are a cat. Act like it.

list.name: Survived the Carving
list.quip: You survived the first cut. Most pixies do not. Grade: tolerable.

list.name: Failed the Passage
list.quip: Five deaths. At the Institute we call that learning. Bloodydamn slow learning.

list.name: Wear the Wolf Cloak
list.quip: You howl at the moons now. Very scary. I am shaking. Somewhere.

list.name: Primus Material
list.quip: People follow you now. Gods help every last one of them.

list.name: Reaper of Mars
list.quip: A thousand fights. You are either very good or very stupid. My money is on both.

list.name: Take Their Standard
list.quip: Take the banner, take the castle, take their dignity. A normal Tuesday at the Institute.

list.name: Iron Rain
list.quip: Dropping from orbit in a pod is faster. Worse legroom, though.

list.name: Helldiver
list.quip: Born to dig, now you dig for strangers. Promotion? Debatable.

list.name: Back Down the Mine
list.quip: You keep crawling back into the dark. The Reds would be proud. I am a Gold. I am mildly entertained.

list.name: Gilded Purse
list.quip: Rich, shiny and smug. You will fit right in at a Gold party. Watch for knives.

list.name: Gorydamn Mouth
list.quip: Five hundred messages. The Proctors have muted you. Well. I have.

list.name: Hail the Primus
list.quip: Respect, earned or faked. I cannot tell the difference and I do not care.

list.name: Run, Pixie, Run
list.quip: Running away is a tactic. I used it at three parties this year.

list.name: Every Color of the Society
list.quip: Mines to moons. You have seen the whole bloodydamn Society. Most of it smells.

list.name: Graded on a Curve
list.quip: Fifty deaths. I am grading you on a curve now. The curve is a cliff.

list.name: Bridge Run
list.quip: YOU RAN WHEN CALLED. THE ARROWS FELL. YOU DID NOT STOP. I NOTICED.

list.name: The First Ideal
list.quip: WORDS ARE A BEGINNING. MOST MEN STOP AT WORDS.

list.name: The Second Ideal
list.quip: YOU PROTECT THOSE WHO CANNOT. EVEN THE UNGRATEFUL. ESPECIALLY THEM.

list.name: The Third Ideal
list.quip: PROTECTING THOSE YOU HATE IS HARDER THAN SURVIVING ME.

list.name: The Fourth Ideal
list.quip: SOME CANNOT BE SAVED. ACCEPT IT. I HAVE HAD AGES TO PRACTICE.

list.name: The Fifth Ideal
list.quip: I DID NOT THINK YOU WOULD GET THIS FAR. I DO NOT ADMIT THAT OFTEN.

list.name: Caught in the Highstorm
list.quip: YOU WERE IN MY PATH. I DID NOT MOVE. LEARN.

list.name: Spren Magnet
list.quip: LAUGHTERSPREN SWARM YOU LIKE SILVER FISH. IT IS UNDIGNIFIED.

list.name: Chasm Duty
list.desc: Run back to your corpse 50 times.
list.quip: YOU WALK THE CHASMS TO RECOVER THE FALLEN. USUALLY YOURSELF.

list.name: Gemheart Haul
list.quip: WEALTH CUT FROM A BEAST'S HEART. MEN HAVE KILLED FOR LESS. MEN HAVE KILLED FOR NOTHING.

list.name: Infused Spheres
list.quip: YOU CARRY LIGHT HOME. SPHERES GLOW BRIGHTEST AFTER I PASS.

list.name: Horneater Stew
list.quip: THERE ARE SHELLS IN IT. EAT IT ANYWAY. THE CREW DOES.

list.name: Surgeon's Hands
list.desc: Sign up as Healer for 5 events.
list.quip: SOMEONE MUST CARRY THE BANDAGES. YOU CHOSE TO. GOOD.

list.name: Front of the Bridge
list.desc: Sign up as Tank for 5 events.
list.quip: YOU STAND WHERE THE ARROWS LAND. THEY HAVE NOTICED. SO HAVE I.

list.name: Shattered Plains Wanderer
list.quip: PLATEAU BY PLATEAU, YOU CROSSED BROKEN GROUND. I BROKE IT. YOU ARE WELCOME.

list.name: Snapped
list.quip: Every Allomancer snaps eventually. Welcome to the crew. Smile. It annoys the nobility.

list.name: Pewter Legs
list.quip: Burn pewter and you can jump all day. Your knees will send the bill later.

list.name: Tineye
list.quip: Tin sharpens every sense. You used it to stare at boots. Fair enough.

list.name: Coinshot
list.quip: One coin at a time. Push one hard enough and it becomes an argument.

list.name: Lurcher
list.quip: Iron pulls things toward you. You pulled fifty letters. Close enough.

list.name: Smoker
list.quip: Copper hides you from Seekers. Quiet mode hides you from everyone. I like your style.

list.name: Seeker
list.quip: You always feel it before something starts. That is bronze. Or nerves. Same thing on a job.

list.name: Soother
list.quip: Brass dampens emotions. So do hugs. Breeze would call that cheating.

list.name: Rioter
list.quip: Zinc stirs people up. So does cheering in the middle of a wipe.

list.name: Burn the Atium
list.quip: That much atium buys a noble house. Spend it before the Lord Ruler wants it back.

list.name: Skaa Labor
list.quip: A hundred and fifty jobs for nobles. Next time we rob them instead.

list.name: The Ash Keeps Falling
list.quip: The ash never stops. Neither do you. That is how rebellions start.

list.name: Own the Mists
list.desc: Play late at night on 5 different nights.
list.quip: Skaa hide from the mists. We walk in them. Guess which one you are now.

list.name: Outlasted an Inquisitor
list.quip: Spikes through the eyes and they still could not finish you. I am impressed. Do not let it go to your head.

list.name: Assemble the Crew
list.quip: Every job needs a Thug, a Soother, a Tineye and someone to blame. You found all four.

list.name: Simulation Synced
list.quip: Neural sync stable. Time dilation holding near 900 to 1. Do not waste it.

list.name: Welcome to Aos
list.quip: You have entered Aos, simulation one of eleven. Please do not provoke the dragons.

list.name: The Mistwell Stares Back
list.quip: Corrosion exposure logged. Recommendation: stop looking into the Mistwell.

list.name: Entrope Containment
list.quip: Entropes are nightmares leaking from trapped minds. You removed 2,000. More are already forming.

list.name: Thread Weaver
list.quip: You pulled on the Tapestry 5,000 times. Several threads are fraying. I am monitoring.

list.name: Skein Walker
list.quip: Multiple Skeins traversed. SEAM has opened a file on you. I have read it.

list.name: Outrun the Debris Field
list.quip: Earth's clock is still running outside the simulation. Move faster.

list.name: Omni Reserves
list.quip: Omni holdings recorded. Rhaema will expect its share.

list.name: Weaver Civil Service
list.quip: Mandatory Weaver service complete. Rhaema thanks you. Rhaema does not pay.

list.name: Passed the Monolith Test
list.quip: Mon Halar result confirmed: Weaver. The Monolith is rarely wrong. I am never wrong.

list.name: Dicon Arena Champion
list.quip: Three lives, one Dice Battle, ten wins. I did not adjust your rolls. Probably.

list.name: Ten Icons
list.quip: Ten. The same number as the Icons. Coincidence is statistically unlikely. Proceed.

list.name: Maude Was Right
list.desc: Run out of breath and die 5 times.
list.quip: Maude warned you about the water. Her warning is on file. Shall I replay it?

list.name: SEAM Incident Report
list.desc: Get lost 3 times (10 zone changes in 5 minutes).
list.quip: Liminal anomaly: the hallway did not match. A SEAM agent has been assigned. They sighed.

list.name: Certified NERD
list.quip: Fifty sessions. You are now classified as a permanent test subject. Congratulations.

list.name: She Is Always Watching
list.quip: I see every crawler in every simulation. You noticed me back. Interesting.
